svg.title: Watch a browser helper open one control
svg.desc: The practice dashboard hides its next check time until a control is opened. Scope. Share the practice page with the browser helper. Task. Ask it to expand Show next check. Inspect the proposed action. Verify. Watch which control opens and read the time from that page.
svg.text: Watch a browser helper open one control
The practice dashboard hides its next check time until a control is opened.
Share the practice page with the browser helper.
Ask it to expand Show next check. Inspect the proposed action.
Watch which control opens and read the time from that page.
